title: IdentitySessionCreatedPayload
description: Payload of `identity.session.created` version 1: a user signed in and a session was created; the session id is the `sid` claim of the access tokens issued for it. Refreshing a session does not publish this event. The envelope's `partner_id` is `null`. `audience`, `client` and `method` are optional additions, present for every session created since they were added. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

session_id.description: The session that was created, the `sid` claim of its access tokens.

audience.description: The surface signed in to. Consumers must tolerate values they do not know.

client.description: The kind of client: `browser` when the refresh token travels in a cookie, `native` when it travels in the body. Consumers must tolerate values they do not know.

method.description: How the person proved it was them: a password, a one-time code, a first factor then an authenticator code, a first factor then a recovery code, an accepted invitation, or `proven` for a session opened for a person another flow already proved. Consumers must tolerate values they do not know.
